audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers' level charts contradicted the packet chart and their own whys[] text at rows 0-4: full/content said Skill at Level 1 while whys[0] says Tryndamere wins it, and said Tryndamere at Levels 2-3 while whys[1]/whys[2] call them even. Rows 3 and 4 were also mislabelled.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Tryndamere / Skill / Skill / Wukong / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere, and the prose in whys[0..4] already matches that. The mirror audit (tryndamere__wukong) records the same realignment of rows 0-4, so both sides now agree.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 flipped in phases[N].side and win[N] as matched pairs, ratings normalised across the whole chart (owner-win 7/10, skill 5/10, enemy-win 3/10), and the phases whys rewritten so each stage states why that side owns it.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why claimed Cyclone's double knockup 'wins every committed brawl' at Level 6, on a stage the chart hands to Tryndamere.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120/100/80s and grants 5s of unkillability; Cyclone displaces but cannot finish through it. The Level 6 spike belongs to Tryndamere, and the Wukong spike is the Level 4-5 window before his Fury bank supports a real Bloodlust heal.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stage now states the 5s unkillable window and the 120s rank-1 cooldown; the Levels 4-5 stage now states Wukong's actual spike (Crushing Blow shred + Nimbus Strike burst before the Fury bank fills).

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2] was headed 'Chase his spin blind' but its body described burning W before a trade — the heading and the interaction did not match. No cooldown-sequencing advice existed anywhere (packet: sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Spinning Slash is a 650-range dash on 12/11/10/9/8s and is both his engage and his escape, so chasing it is the actual mistake. Undying Rage's 120s rank-1 downtime is the concrete window the page never named.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d rewritten around Spinning Slash being his escape; dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the real 12s / 120-100-80s numbers and a 'start the clock when it pops' instruction; spikes[1].text now says Cyclone displaces through R and to fight during the 120s it is down.

audit.why: packet suspectNames flags "Crushing Blow's" in spikes[0].text as a probable wrong name. Crushing Blow is Wukong's real Q. False positive; left unchanged.

edits.before: Q-AA poke wins the short exchanges. Identify how Tryndamere contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: His auto range and Bloodlust healing win Level 1, so farm it out and hold Crushing Blow for his step-up, not for the wave.

edits.before: W clone bails out any misstep and baits his answer. Only take the trade when Tryndamere's Undying Rage is down.
edits.after: Even at 2: Warrior Trickster bails any misstep, and Spinning Slash is 12s at rank 1 if he burns it to engage you.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Tryndamere must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but so is his: Spinning Slash is engage and escape, so hold the wave near you and make him walk in.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Undying Rage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window before 6: Crushing Blow's armor shred plus Nimbus Strike burst him down while his Fury bank is still too small to heal.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Tryndamere's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Undying Rage is 5 seconds you cannot kill through and it is back every 120s at rank 1 — Cyclone displaces him, it does not finish him.

edits.before: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: matchup-defining — Unkillable 5s. Burst after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Undying Rage: 5s unkillable, back every 120/100/80s — start the clock the second it pops. - Spinning Slash: 12s at rank 1, and once he spins in he has no escape. - Cyclone: kill windows only, never chip.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Burst after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Unkillable 5s, then 120s of downtime at rank 1 — that gap is your all-in.

edits.before: Burning W before the trade starts — the clone IS your defense, and committing without it means eating his full combo.
edits.after: Spinning Slash is his escape too — chasing it into fog lets him spin out and heal back, and your clone is spent for nothing.

edits.before: Undying Rage (R) makes him unkillable for 5 seconds regardless of your damage, so any all-in that relies on the killing blow gets denied. Cyclone's knock-up can still displace him, but you can't burst him through R.
edits.after: Undying Rage makes him unkillable 5 seconds regardless of your damage, so any all-in relying on the killing blow is denied. Cyclone still displaces him through it — knock him off you, then fight during the 120s it is down.

notes: ownerKit was null in this brief, so no Wukong cooldowns were written — only Tryndamere's verified numbers. packet suspectName 'Crushing Blow's' is a FALSE POSITIVE (Wukong's real Q name); left unchanged. Level-chart flips are proposed as one matched full+content group.
